messages:
elaine.docs: Opening PR - reorganize private install checklist + add port aliasing table and egress SNI note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1789 :eyes:

mike.eng: taking a look. Quick question — the firewall example uses port 8500, but our runtime binds 8501 by default in private. Should we mention both or show how to override?

elaine.docs: good catch. I intended to show the overridable ENV var. I'll add snippet. Also adding a short table with common aliases (8500 -> legacy, 8501 -> runtime-v2).

sanjay.security: HSM section needs a callout about PKCS#11 slot numbers — some HSMs present slot 0 vs slot 1. Can we add this and an example for yubihsm vs SoftHSM?

thomas.docs: I can paste an example. For SoftHSM config:
```
pkcs11_module: /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
slot: 0
pin: 1234
```
and for YubiHSM it's usually slot 1 and a different token label.

kevin.oncall: also add a note that the conn-checker tool will fail if NAT SNAT isn't doing address-preserving; our troubleshooting playbook needs a one-liner to detect it.

rachel.support: can you add the conn-checker example? Support sees this a lot in installs.

elaine.docs: yes. adding a short command example for conn-checker:
```
./conn-checker --target https://kms.private.local --port 443 --timeout 5s
```
and a follow-up curl fallback sample for debugging the TLS chain.

devex-bot: docs-linter: linkcheck failed on 'docs/private/networks.md' -> 404

elaine.docs: thanks bot — will fix the broken anchor and update the PR. @mike.eng @sanjay.security can you review the KMS fallback paragraph? I wrote it as a short flowchart but maybe it's too prescriptive.

mike.eng: flowchart looks fine. One nit: mention that prefix caching can be disabled per-route to avoid stale keys when rotating KMS variants.

sanjay.security: agree. Also add a sentence about auditing PKCS11 label changes to avoid silent key swaps.

elaine.docs: done. Pushed new commit, fixed link, added SoftHSM/Yubi examples, conn-checker snippet, and firewall override note. PTAL.

ci-bot: build-docs: success ✅

mike.eng: LGTM from eng side. small grammar nit in the HSM note but not blocking.

rachel.support: approved from support. I'll add a short KB link once the PR merges.

elaine.docs: thanks all — merging after 1h if no other comments. I'll follow up with a short migration note for customers who use legacy port aliases.

kevin.oncall: thx. Please also raise a release note so oncall knows the troubleshooting steps shipped.

elaine.docs: will do, adding to the release notes draft now :memo:
